semiconductor_relevance: High — Jade Design Automation specializes in Electronic Design Automation for register management in SoC development, which is critical for semiconductor design.
summary: Jade Design Automation is an EDA company focused on register management throughout the entire SoC lifecycle, from system architecture to software launch. With a commitment to high-quality software and industry-leading support, they serve a global customer base across North America, Europe, and Asia.
